name: Neukrotimaja chetvjorka
source:
"The Adventurous Four" is a worthy sequel to our "Wild Island Quest"
visual novel, which was published a few years ago. In this game-book
you'll have to go on a journey full of dangers and adventures. The
main characters are all good friends, ready to overcome difficulties
to save each other in this all-new quest.

Non-linear plot and multiple paths, will no doubt, draw attention of
those who like this genre, where the chain of events depends on the
player's choices.

Game on with high spirits!

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/815070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《冒險四人組》是《荒島探險》視覺小說的優秀續作，後者幾年前發售。在這部遊戲書中，你將踏上充滿危險與冒險的旅程。主角們都是好朋友，願意克服困難，在全新任務中拯救彼此。

非線性劇情與多條路線，一定會吸引喜歡這種類型的玩家；接下來會發生哪些事，全看玩家怎麼選。

帶著高昂士氣開始遊戲吧！

[來源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/815070/]Steam[/url]]
